Implemented via std::thread::scope at all 4 call sites: assemble::city_view (per-rig bd.status fetched concurrently), cmd_queue (bd.status+bd.list), cmd_agents (bd.list+gc.rig_status), render::watch::render_rig (bd.status+bd.list(full non-closed set)+gc.rig_status). Adapters.gc/bd gained +Sync (git deliberately excluded -- its RefCell fetch-throttle cache isn't Sync and isn't captured cross-thread). Each call site binds the specific adapter field (e.g. 'let bd_adapter = adapters.bd.as_ref();') before the scope block rather than capturing the whole Adapters struct, since Adapters itself still isn't Sync (git field). Redundant bd.list call eliminated: assemble::dag_view split into a fetching wrapper + pure dag_view_from_beads(adapters, rig, beads, now), so render_rig passes in the same full bead list it already fetched for queue/agents instead of a second bd.list call. Error semantics preserved exactly: city_view still degrades per-rig via .ok(), queue/agents/watch still hard-error via ? with first-error-wins ordering (join().expect() only panics on thread panic, not adapter error -- the Result is joined and propagated with ? same as before). Verified with a controlled deterministic harness (fake gc/bd stub scripts each doing sleep 0.5s, avoiding live carbon-city load noise which initially gave misleading numbers): queue command ~1.958s sequential -> ~0.541s parallel; agents ~1.064s -> ~0.531s. All 102 tests pass (91 unit + 11 e2e), 0 clippy warnings.
